title: The Distant Inventory
author: Yara Sandoval
blurb: Jonah Eriksen, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
